name: Cursor
description: AI coding environment with an agent for building software, plus cloud agents on paid plans.
pricing_summary: Free plan $0/month with limited agent and chat usage; Premium $30/month, Super $100/month, Ultra $200/month; Teams from $30/user/month.

name: Claude Code
description: Anthropic's coding agent, included with Claude paid plans.
pricing_summary: Included with Claude Pro (listed $17/month with annual discount) and Max (from $100/month); the Free plan's feature table lists Claude Code as 'No'.

name: OpenAI Codex
description: OpenAI's coding agent available in the CLI, IDE extension, web and desktop app.
pricing_summary: Included in ChatGPT plans: Free $0, Go $8/month, Plus $20/month, Pro from $100/month; API-key usage billed at API rates.

name: GitHub Copilot
description: GitHub's AI coding assistant for editors, the CLI and GitHub itself.
pricing_summary: Free plan ($0, limited chat and agent usage) plus paid Pro, Pro+ and Max plans; exact paid prices differ across sections of the plans page, so check the official page.

name: Cline
description: Open-source autonomous coding agent that runs in your editor and works with your own model API keys.
pricing_summary: Free for individual developers (open-source extension); you pay only for AI inference with your chosen provider. Enterprise is custom.

name: Aider
description: Open-source AI pair-programming tool that runs in your terminal and integrates with git.
pricing_summary: Free open-source software (Apache-2.0 per its GitHub repo); you pay your chosen LLM provider for usage.

name: Windsurf
description: AI coding tool with agents and tab completions, available as an editor and CLI.
pricing_summary: Free $0/month (light quota); Pro $20/month; Max $200/month; Team $80/month.

name: Lovable
description: AI software engineer that builds websites and web apps from chat prompts.
pricing_summary: Free plan: 5 build credits per day (up to 30/month) plus 20 monthly Cloud credits; paid Pro and Business plans are priced by credits.

name: Bolt
description: Prompt-to-app builder for creating and deploying web apps in the browser.
pricing_summary: Free plan with a 300,000 token daily limit; Pro $25/month billed monthly; Teams $30/month per member.

name: v0
description: Vercel's AI app and UI builder that deploys to Vercel and syncs with GitHub.
pricing_summary: Free $0/month with a daily message limit; Plus $30/user/month; Business $100/user/month.

name: Replit
description: Browser-based platform where Replit Agent builds, hosts and deploys apps from prompts.
pricing_summary: Free mode available (no credit card required); Core $20/month ($18 billed annually); Pro $100/month ($90 billed annually); Enterprise custom.

name: Supabase
description: Open-source-based Postgres backend platform with auth, storage and APIs.
pricing_summary: Free $0/month (free projects paused after 1 week of inactivity, limit of 2 active projects); Pro from $25/month; Team from $599/month.

name: Neon
description: Serverless Postgres with branching and usage-based pricing.
pricing_summary: Free $0/month; Launch and Scale plans are usage-based.

name: Turso
description: SQLite-compatible cloud database platform built for many lightweight databases.
pricing_summary: Free $0/month (100 databases, 5GB storage); Developer $4.99/month; Scaler $24.92/month; Scaler Pro $416.58/month.

name: PlanetScale
description: Managed MySQL (Vitess) and Postgres databases.
pricing_summary: Postgres single node starting at $5/month; Metal starting at $50/month; no free plan shown on the pricing page.

name: Pinecone
description: Fully managed vector database for search and AI applications.
pricing_summary: Starter plan is free; Builder $20/month flat; Standard from $50/month minimum usage (3-week trial with $300 credits).

name: Qdrant
description: Open-source vector search engine with a managed cloud.
pricing_summary: Free tier 'free forever' (single-node cluster, 4 GB disk); Standard tier usage-based; Premium tier available.

name: Weaviate
description: Vector database with managed cloud clusters.
pricing_summary: Free forever $0/mo sandbox (no credit card; 1 cluster per user); Flex from $45/mo pay-as-you-go; higher tiers available.

name: Chroma
description: Open-source search infrastructure for AI with a hosted cloud.
pricing_summary: Starter $0/month plus usage with free credits; Team $250/month plus usage; usage-billed per GiB written, stored and queried.

name: Firebase
description: Google's app development platform with databases, auth, hosting and functions.
pricing_summary: No-cost Spark plan with included usage; pay-as-you-go Blaze plan above that.

name: LangChain
description: Framework (MIT-licensed on GitHub) for building agents and LLM apps, with LangSmith for observability.
pricing_summary: Framework is open source; LangSmith Developer $0/seat then pay-as-you-go, Plus $39/seat/month, Enterprise custom.

name: LlamaIndex
description: Data framework (MIT-licensed on GitHub) and LlamaCloud for document parsing and retrieval for LLM apps.
pricing_summary: LlamaCloud Free $0/month (10K credits); Starter $50/month (40K credits); higher tiers available.

name: CrewAI
description: Framework (MIT-licensed on GitHub) and platform for building multi-agent workflows.
pricing_summary: Basic plan is free; Enterprise is custom pricing.

name: AutoGen
description: Microsoft's open-source framework for creating multi-agent AI applications.
pricing_summary: Free open-source software (MIT and CC-BY-4.0 licenses per its GitHub repo).

name: OpenAI API
description: OpenAI's developer API for GPT models, embeddings, audio and image generation.
pricing_summary: Pay per 1M tokens (e.g. gpt-6-luna $0.10 input / $0.50 output; gpt-6.1-sol $2.00 / $10.00); free tier not stated on the pricing page.

name: Anthropic API (Claude Platform)
description: Anthropic's developer platform for building with Claude models.
pricing_summary: Usage-based per million tokens (MTok) by model with prompt-caching rates; free tier not stated on the pricing page.

name: Google Gemini API
description: Google's Gemini Developer API for building with Gemini models.
pricing_summary: Free tier available ('start building free of charge with generous limits'), then prepaid and pay-as-you-go paid tier per 1M tokens.

name: Groq
description: AI inference cloud built on Groq's LPU hardware.
pricing_summary: Pricing not verified: the fetched pricing page showed no plan details.

name: OpenRouter
description: Unified API for accessing many LLM providers and models.
pricing_summary: Free plan (25+ free models, 50 requests/day); Standard pay-as-you-go with 5.5% platform fee; Business 8%.

name: Ollama
description: Tool for running open models locally, with optional cloud models.
pricing_summary: Free $0 (download and run models; cloud models via pay-as-you-go credits); Pro $20/month; Max tier also listed.

name: n8n
description: Workflow automation platform with AI capabilities, hosted or self-hosted.
pricing_summary: Cloud plans billed by workflow executions with a free trial (no credit card for most plans); a self-hosted option exists. Exact free-plan status not confirmed.

name: Zapier
description: No-code automation connecting thousands of apps, with AI features.
pricing_summary: Free forever $0/month; Professional from $19.99/month; Team from $69/month.

name: Make
description: Visual automation platform for building scenarios across apps.
pricing_summary: Free plan with 1,000 credits/month; paid plans by credit volume (Core, Pro, Teams, Enterprise).
